notes: The אֵת before יְהוָה takes the 'of' of 'inquired of', one of rule 16's three named families, rather than going unrepresented.
עַל־כֵּן → 'therefore' is one rule 30 fusion headed on the lexeme-bearing כֵּן; heading on the preposition, as the packet's gloss placement suggests, is the named alternative.
